nodes.description: Owner address stored in BotProtected; assigned from tx.origin in the Blackhole constructor and used as the sole authorization for privileged functions.
External contract address used for the bot-protection hook; invoked through low-level calls in the checkBots modifier and in list().
Public Uniswap pair address, computed in the constructor via pairForUniswap(wrappedBinance, address(this)).
Uniswap V2 router instance hard-coded to 0x7a250d...488D; used for addLiquidityETH and granted unlimited allowance in the constructor.
Wrapped BNB/ETH token address used as the paired asset when computing the Uniswap pair.
Public token balance mapping of the Blackhole contract; written directly in transferFrom and arbitrarily overwritten in list().
Public allowance mapping; written in approve, decremented in transferFrom and pre-set to uint(-1) in the constructor.
Total supply constant (1e30) used in the unchecked 6% mint computation inside list().
Private ERC20 balance mapping updated by _transfer/_mint/_burn.
Private ERC20 allowance nested mapping updated by _approve.
Private ERC20 total supply updated by _mint and _burn.
Constructor of BotProtected storing the bot protection contract address.
Modifier performing an external low-level call into protectionFromBots before the modified function body executes.
Checked addition helper.
Checked subtraction helpers (two overloads).
Checked multiplication helper.
Checked division helpers (two overloads).
Standard ERC20 transfer forwarding to _transfer with msg.sender.
Standard ERC20 transferFrom using allowance checks and _transfer.
Internal ERC20 balance movement using SafeMath.
Internal ERC20 allowance setter.
Internal ERC20 mint increasing supply and balance.
Internal ERC20 burn decreasing balance and supply.
Constructor setting owner = tx.origin, computing the Uniswap pair and granting unlimited allowances.
Payable transfer that simply delegates to transferFrom(msg.sender, _to, _value).
Payable transferFrom with the checkBots modifier and unchecked balance/allowance arithmetic; performs external call before state updates.
Payable approve that writes allowance[msg.sender][_spender] without restrictions.
Owner-only function performing an arbitrary delegatecall to a caller-supplied address and calldata.
Pure function computing the CREATE2 Uniswap pair address from two token addresses.
Owner-only listing function that rewrites balances, adds liquidity via the router with a block.timestamp deadline and performs a low-level external call.
Caller-controlled address used for allowance spending, approvals and authorization checks.
Transaction origin used to set owner and grant unlimited allowance; phishable authorization source.
Block timestamp used to build the router deadline (block.timestamp + 600) in list().
Arbitrary delegatecall(a, b) executing attacker-supplied code in the contract's storage context.
Low-level .call() into protectionFromBots with selector 0x15274141 executed before state updates in transferFrom.
Low-level .call() into protectionFromBots with selector 0xd5eaf4c3 executed before the balance-writing loop in list().
External router addLiquidityETH call whose deadline is block.timestamp + 600.
Unchecked allowance[_from][msg.sender] -= _value under Solidity 0.7 without SafeMath.
Unchecked balanceOf[_from] -= _value and balanceOf[_to] += _value under Solidity 0.7.
Unchecked multiplication totalSupply * 6 / 100 used to mint the owner's balance.

Array of amounts written directly into arbitrary holder balances.

Success flag returned by the low-level bot protection call and required to be true.

Higher-ordered token address used in the pair hash.

edges.reason: owner is assigned directly from tx.origin in the constructor, so privileges inherit a phishable origin.
BotProtected constructor stores the supplied address into protectionFromBots.
Blackhole constructor forwards _botProtection into the BotProtected constructor.
The checkBots modifier always performs the low-level call into protectionFromBots.
_from is ABI-encoded as the first argument of the bot-check selector.
_to is ABI-encoded into the bot-check call arguments.
_value is ABI-encoded into the bot-check call arguments.
uniPair is passed as the pair argument to the bot-check call.
The external call inside the modifier executes before the balance and allowance updates of transferFrom, allowing reentrancy into the token.
The returned success flag is checked by require(notABot) inside the modifier.
transferFrom decrements the allowance with unchecked arithmetic under Solidity 0.7.
transferFrom mutates balances with unchecked += and -= operations.
msg.sender selects which spender allowance slot is read and decremented in transferFrom.
msg.sender is compared with _from to decide whether allowance must be spent.
_from is the account debited by the unchecked balance subtraction.
_to is the account credited by the unchecked balance addition.
_value is the amount applied to both balance updates.
transfer simply forwards execution to transferFrom.
msg.sender is used as the _from argument when transfer calls transferFrom.
_to is forwarded from transfer into transferFrom.
_value is forwarded from transfer into transferFrom.
approve writes the allowance mapping for any caller without additional checks.
_spender is used as the second key of the allowance mapping.
_value is stored as the allowance amount.
msg.sender is the allowance owner in approve, so anyone can set their own allowances arbitrarily.
delegate executes an arbitrary delegatecall guarded only by the owner check.
The owner gate on delegate derives from tx.origin, so the delegatecall privilege can be phished.
Parameter a is the target address of the delegatecall.
Parameter b is the raw calldata executed through delegatecall.
msg.sender == owner is the only guard protecting the delegatecall.
list performs a low-level call into protectionFromBots while rewriting state.
The external call in list occurs before the balance-writing loop, enabling reentrant calls into the token.
_toAddresses is ABI-encoded into the protectionFromBots call payload.
list is protected only by require(msg.sender == owner) where owner is tx.origin.
list invokes routerForUniswap.addLiquidityETH with ETH value.
The router deadline is derived from block.timestamp, making the liquidity call miner-manipulable.
_numList is the amountTokenDesired/amountTokenMin supplied to addLiquidityETH.
list computes the owner balance with unchecked multiplication and division.
totalSupply is the operand of the unchecked 6% mint computation.
_numList is written straight into balanceOf[address(this)].
_amounts are written directly into the balances of arbitrary addresses.
The loop index i walks _toAddresses while overwriting balanceOf.
list arbitrarily overwrites the balances of any address without accounting checks.
ERC20.transferFrom delegates balance movement to _transfer.
ERC20.transferFrom uses msg.sender as the spender for allowance consumption.
_transfer applies SafeMath subtraction and addition to the ERC20 balance mapping.
The Blackhole constructor sets owner, establishing tx.origin-based privileges.
The constructor computes uniPair through pairForUniswap.
The constructor grants unlimited allowances to the router and to tx.origin.
The address returned by pairForUniswap is stored in uniPair.
routerForUniswap is the spender granted unlimited allowance in the constructor.
The checkBots modifier reads protectionFromBots to perform its external call.
list calls into protectionFromBots using the stored address.
tokenA is part of the pair hash input.
tokenB is part of the pair hash input.
wrappedBinance is passed as tokenA when computing uniPair.
routerForUniswap is the target of the addLiquidityETH call in list.
The constructor uses tx.origin as the owner identity and allowance beneficiary.
